en: Do you truly intend to defeat me?
Yes, of course.
...Don't make me laugh, you whelp!!!!
I am Van Helsing.
note: Van Helsing self-introduction, rows 654-430 in forward order.

en: I'm a university professor, and a doctor too.
My former student, Jonathan Harker, and
my fellow physician, Dr. Jack Seward,
both sent word to me, you see,
and so now, as a vampire hunter,
I have come to this port town.
My titles, however,
are not just professor and doctor.
My other title is that of
a researcher of the paranormal...
Not that the world knows much of it.
I have read every text there is, and so I
know the means to defeat a vampire.
The most effective way to defeat a vampire...
is to seek out its coffin.
If you can find it, you should be able to deal
the vampire a fatal wound...
When my best friend Jonathan asks a favor,
I can hardly refuse.
So that's why I've

en: come to this town
as a vampire hunter.

note: Vampire referred to as 'it' (gender not stated).

en: I won't stand for it...!
I'll cut it down with this sword of mine!!
This sword I carry is called a blessed sword,
and it's quite something, you know...
Blessed by God, it has the power to sever evil.
I'm Quincey Morris.
I hail from Texas, in America.
Back in my student days in England,
Professor Van Helsing looked after me.
I've come here as his escort.
Professor Van Helsing saw promise in
my marksmanship, you see...
Well, when I'm on the job, vampires
go down in one shot.
Dang... Last night I took a shot at a bat
and let it get away.
This wasn't how it was supposed to go...
You won't get away from me...
note: Player (polite) taunting an opponent; reply 124/100 knows the listener is a vampire (coffin). Speaker pair not certain; matches the M0A #85C wording 'Our showdown comes... with the night'.

en: Our showdown comes with the night.
You're the one who should strap your coffin
to your back and get out of this town, fast.
I hear Nosferatu and Dhampir have often
been appearing around these parts.
Have you heard any such rumors?
<Answer>
<Don't answer>
Yes. I've heard about it.
Yeah. I've heard.
Then show me where on this map.
They're said to appear around here.
I see. Thank you.
I'm sorry.
